notes.title: Seafarers Release
notes.notes: Seafarers is now officially released! After an exciting Steam Next Fest and a lot of time and hard work, we are finally here! As I did with Toast Defense, I plan on spending some more time on Seafarers interacting with the community and looking at any potential updates as well before looking at my next project (*spoilers* A new Toast Defense update). Hope you Enjoy!

notes.title: Seafarers Demo Release!
notes.notes:
Seafarers is participating in the Steam Next Fest! The demo is available now and will be available throughout the festival! I am planning on posting an official content roadmap for Seafarers in the coming days so keep a lookout! Until then, enjoy the game and tell everyone about it! 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1600960/Seafarers/
